title: Fix TypeScript compilation errors across core, metadata, and objectql packages
body:
CI build failed due to multiple TypeScript type errors across three packages. This PR fixes all compilation errors to restore the build.

## Changes

### 1. @objectstack/core - Security Type Imports
- Updated imports in `packages/core/src/security/security-scanner.ts` to use correct type names
- Changed `SecurityVulnerability` → `KernelSecurityVulnerability`
- Changed `SecurityScanResult` → `KernelSecurityScanResult`
- Updated all type annotations throughout the file (8 occurrences total)

```typescript
// Before
import type { 
  SecurityVulnerability,
  SecurityScanResult
} from '@objectstack/spec/kernel';

// After
import type { 
  KernelSecurityVulnerability,
  KernelSecurityScanResult
} from '@objectstack/spec/kernel';
```

### 2. @objectstack/metadata - Date to String Conversions
- Fixed `memory-loader.ts` - Convert Date to ISO string for `mtime` field
- Fixed `remote-loader.ts` - Convert Date to ISO string for `mtime` field
- Fixed `metadata-manager.ts` - Added type assertion for generic return type

The `MetadataStats.mtime` field is defined as `z.string().datetime()` in the spec, requiring ISO string format.

### 3. @objectstack/objectql - HookContext Type Casting
- Fixed `engine.ts` - Added explicit type casting for HookContext.input fields (9 locations)
- HookContext.input is typed as `z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())` for flexibility, requiring runtime type assertions

## Testing

- ✅ All 19 packages build successfully
- ✅ All 3073 tests pass across 97 test files
- ✅ Zero TypeScript compilation errors
- ✅ No runtime errors introduced

The changes are minimal and surgical, focusing only on fixing type compatibility issues without altering any business logic or runtime behavior.
